source.titleEnglish: Email the Hotel a Written Incident Summary
source.objectiveEnglish: Write a clear, formal summary of the incident and your requests, sharing only the health details Lucía approved.
source.speakingEnglish: You are drafting the email to Inés Soler, and the AI is Lucía, your friend: read your summary aloud, check which health details she approves, and organize it with en primer lugar, a continuación, sin embargo, por lo tanto and por último.

sourceGrammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (en primer lugar, a continuación, sin embargo, por lo tanto, por último)

examples.es: En primer lugar, mi amiga sufrió una reacción alérgica durante el desayuno.
examples.en: First, my friend had an allergic reaction during breakfast.

examples.es: Sin embargo, nadie nos informó de los ingredientes; por lo tanto, solicitamos una revisión.
examples.en: However, no one told us the ingredients; therefore, we request a review.

titleFrenchDraft: Un courriel sur l’incident, avec le consentement de Lucía
focusFrenchDraft: Rédiger à l’hôtel de Valence un compte rendu formel de l’incident et de ses demandes, en ne communiquant que les données de santé approuvées par Lucía.

cards.sourceNoteEnglish: Spain usage; much of Latin America says la estadía.
Spain: businesses must provide this form on request.
Standard formal sign-off before your name.

cards.sourceSpanish: Estimada señora Soler: le escribo en relación con lo ocurrido el martes.
cards.supportEnglish: Dear Ms. Soler: I am writing regarding what happened on Tuesday.
cards.targetFrenchDraft: Madame Soler, je vous écris au sujet de ce qui s’est passé mardi.
cards.sourceNoteEnglish: Formal. Spanish emails put a colon, not a comma, after the greeting.

cards.sourceSpanish: En primer lugar, quisiera agradecer la rápida atención de su personal.
cards.supportEnglish: First of all, I would like to thank your staff for their quick response.
cards.targetFrenchDraft: Tout d’abord, je tiens à remercier votre personnel pour sa réaction rapide.

cards.sourceSpanish: A continuación, resumo brevemente lo que ocurrió durante el desayuno.
cards.supportEnglish: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.
cards.targetFrenchDraft: Ci-dessous, je résume brièvement ce qui s’est passé pendant le petit-déjeuner.

cards.sourceSpanish: Sin embargo, la carta de alérgenos no estaba a la vista.
cards.supportEnglish: However, the allergen menu was not on display.
cards.targetFrenchDraft: Cependant, la carte des allergènes n’était pas visible.

cards.sourceSpanish: Por lo tanto, les solicito una respuesta por escrito sobre lo sucedido.
cards.supportEnglish: Therefore, I request a written reply about what happened.
cards.targetFrenchDraft: Par conséquent, je vous demande une réponse écrite sur ce qui s’est passé.

cards.sourceSpanish: Por último, quedo a la espera de su respuesta.
cards.supportEnglish: Finally, I look forward to your reply.

cards.sourceSpanish: Lucía, ¿te parece bien si menciono que fuiste a urgencias?
cards.supportEnglish: Lucía, is it OK if I mention that you went to the ER?
cards.targetFrenchDraft: Lucía, cela te convient-il si je mentionne que tu es allée aux urgences ?

cards.sourceSpanish: No pondré nada del informe médico sin tu permiso.
cards.supportEnglish: I won't include anything from the medical report without your permission.
cards.targetFrenchDraft: Je n’inclurai rien du rapport médical sans ton autorisation.

reader.sourceSpanish: En su habitación del hotel de Valencia, Emma escribe el resumen del incidente para Inés Soler, responsable de atención al cliente.
reader.supportEnglish: In her room at the hotel in Valencia, Emma writes the summary of the incident for Inés Soler, the customer service manager.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Dans sa chambre de l’hôtel à Valence, Emma rédige le résumé de l’incident à l’intention d’Inés Soler, responsable du service clientèle.

reader.sourceSpanish: En el asunto pone: Reacción alérgica en el desayuno del martes 13 de octubre.
reader.supportEnglish: In the subject line she puts: Allergic reaction at breakfast on Tuesday, October 13.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Dans l’objet, elle écrit : Réaction allergique au petit-déjeuner du mardi 13 octobre.

reader.sourceSpanish: Lucía, su amiga, está sentada en la cama y decide qué datos de salud quiere compartir con el hotel.
reader.supportEnglish: Lucía, her friend, is sitting on the bed and decides which health information she wants to share with the hotel.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Lucía, son amie, est assise sur le lit et décide quelles données de santé elle veut communiquer à l’hôtel.

reader.sourceSpanish: Emma: Lucía, ¿te parece bien si menciono que fuiste a urgencias?
reader.supportEnglish: Emma: Lucía, is it OK if I mention that you went to the ER?
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Emma : Lucía, cela te convient-il si je mentionne que tu es allée aux urgences ?

reader.sourceSpanish: Lucía: Sí, pero no menciones el diagnóstico ni los medicamentos, por favor.
reader.supportEnglish: Lucía: Yes, but don't mention the diagnosis or the medications, please.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Lucía : Oui, mais ne mentionne ni le diagnostic ni les médicaments, s’il te plaît.

reader.sourceSpanish: Emma: No pondré nada del informe médico sin tu permiso.
reader.supportEnglish: Emma: I won't include anything from the medical report without your permission.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Emma : Je n’inclurai rien du rapport médical sans ton autorisation.

reader.sourceSpanish: Para Lucía, la confidencialidad es importante, así que su consentimiento solo cubre la alergia a la almendra y la visita a urgencias.
reader.supportEnglish: For Lucía, confidentiality is important, so her consent only covers the almond allergy and the visit to the ER.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Pour Lucía, la confidentialité est importante ; son consentement ne couvre donc que l’allergie à l’amande et le passage aux urgences.

reader.sourceSpanish: Estimada señora Soler: le escribo en relación con lo ocurrido el martes.
reader.supportEnglish: Dear Ms. Soler: I am writing regarding what happened on Tuesday.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Madame Soler, je vous écris au sujet de ce qui s’est passé mardi.

reader.sourceSpanish: En primer lugar, quisiera agradecer la rápida atención de su personal.
reader.supportEnglish: First of all, I would like to thank your staff for their quick response.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Tout d’abord, je tiens à remercier votre personnel pour sa réaction rapide.

reader.sourceSpanish: A continuación, resumo brevemente lo que ocurrió durante el desayuno.
reader.supportEnglish: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Ci-dessous, je résume brièvement ce qui s’est passé pendant le petit-déjeuner.

reader.sourceSpanish: Durante nuestra estancia, mi amiga comió un bizcocho con almendra, tuvo una reacción alérgica y fue a urgencias.
reader.supportEnglish: During our stay, my friend ate a sponge cake with almond, had an allergic reaction and went to the ER.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Pendant notre séjour, mon amie a mangé un gâteau à l’amande, a eu une réaction allergique et s’est rendue aux urgences.

reader.sourceSpanish: Sin embargo, la carta de alérgenos no estaba a la vista.
reader.supportEnglish: However, the allergen menu was not on display.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Cependant, la carte des allergènes n’était pas visible.

reader.sourceSpanish: Por lo tanto, les solicito una respuesta por escrito sobre lo sucedido.
reader.supportEnglish: Therefore, I request a written reply about what happened.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Par conséquent, je vous demande une réponse écrite sur ce qui s’est passé.

reader.sourceSpanish: También les pido una disculpa y una revisión de la carta de alérgenos en un plazo de 15 días.
reader.supportEnglish: I also ask for an apology and a review of the allergen menu within a time frame of 15 days.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Je vous demande également des excuses et une révision de la carte des allergènes dans un délai de 15 jours.

reader.sourceSpanish: Adjunto una copia de la hoja de reclamaciones que rellenamos en recepción.
reader.supportEnglish: I am attaching a copy of the official complaint form that we filled out at the front desk.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Je joins une copie du formulaire officiel de réclamation que nous avons rempli à la réception.

reader.sourceSpanish: Por último, quedo a la espera de su respuesta.
reader.supportEnglish: Finally, I look forward to your reply.

reader.sourceSpanish: Antes de enviar el correo, Emma revisa el archivo adjunto y confirma que no incluye el informe médico.
reader.supportEnglish: Before sending the email, Emma checks the attachment and confirms that it does not include the medical report.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Avant d’envoyer le courriel, Emma vérifie la pièce jointe et confirme qu’elle ne contient pas le rapport médical.

reader.sourceSpanish: Para la despedida, Emma escribe: Atentamente, Emma Clarke.
reader.supportEnglish: For the sign-off, Emma writes: Sincerely, Emma Clarke.
reader.targetFrenchDraft: Pour terminer, Emma écrit : Cordialement, Emma Clarke.

speakingDraft.roleEnglish: You are Emma drafting the Valencia hotel email to Inés Soler. The AI plays Lucía, your friend, who chooses what health information she consents to share.
speakingDraft.openingFrench: Emma : Lucía, cela te convient-il si je mentionne que tu es allée aux urgences ?
objectivesEnglish: Check Lucía’s consent before including the almond allergy and ER visit, and exclude diagnosis, medications and the medical report.
Read the factual Tuesday breakfast summary aloud using formal connectors in order.
Ask Inés Soler for an apology, a written reply and an allergen-menu review within 15 days.
Attach only the official complaint form and confirm the attachment contains no medical report.
speakingDraft.closureFrench: Emma : Je n’inclurai rien du rapport médical sans ton autorisation.

formsDraft.french: Tout d’abord, je tiens à remercier votre personnel pour sa réaction rapide.
formsDraft.english: First of all, I would like to thank your staff for their quick response.
formsDraft.noteEnglish: Formal connector opens the report; votre addresses Ms. Soler formally.

formsDraft.french: Ci-dessous, je résume brièvement ce qui s’est passé pendant le petit-déjeuner.
formsDraft.english: Below, I briefly summarize what happened during breakfast.
formsDraft.noteEnglish: Je résume is present tense in a formal written report; ci-dessous refers to text that follows.

formsDraft.french: Cependant, la carte des allergènes n’était pas visible.
formsDraft.english: However, the allergen menu was not on display.
formsDraft.noteEnglish: Cependant introduces the contrast; n’était pas visible reports the source condition, not an inferred cause.

formsDraft.french: Par conséquent, je vous demande une réponse écrite sur ce qui s’est passé.
formsDraft.english: Therefore, I request a written reply about what happened.
formsDraft.noteEnglish: Par conséquent links the stated concern to Emma’s request; je vous demande uses formal vous.

formsDraft.english: Finally, I look forward to your reply.
formsDraft.noteEnglish: Enfin closes the sequence; the draft uses a formal written register.

reviewNotesEnglish: Keep Valencia, Inés Soler, Emma, Lucía, the Tuesday October 13 subject, almond-containing cake, allergic reaction and ER visit. The older Montréal/Léa scene is trace evidence only.
Lucía approves disclosure of only the almond allergy and ER visit; she excludes diagnosis, medications and anything from the medical report. Review privacy wording without broadening her consent.
Spain’s hoja de reclamaciones is an official complaint form in this source; check the French term against the Spanish administrative context rather than replacing it with a generic incident note.
The source asks for an apology and allergen-menu review within 15 days and a written reply; it does not promise a remedy or state a cause beyond the source facts.

Review formal email greeting and closing, the choice of cordialement for sincerely, and clinical/dictionary senses with a qualified French reviewer. Neither AI nor the structural validator grants approval.
